
# Setup

Import necessary libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(readxl)
library(FNN)
```

Set default projection, tmap settings, and standard distance for deduplication (in metres)
```{r}
crs = 32636

tmap_mode(mode = "view")

priv_dist = 30
dist_thresholds = c(100, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000)

dedup_names <- c("semi" = "Semi-Conservative", "agg" = "Aggressive", "cons" = "Conservative")
source_names <- c("all" = "Any Source (incl. surf. water)",
                    "nosurf" = "Any Source (excl. surf. water)",
                    "imp" = "Improved Source",
                    "impyearround" = "Year-Round Improved Source")
```

# Import Data

## Apac / Kwania Boundary
```{r}
apac_kwania = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Apac Kwania/ApacKwania.shp"), crs)
```


## Town Centres
```{r}
aduku = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Town Centres/aduku town centre/aduku_town_centre.shp"), crs)%>%
  mutate(town = "Aduku")%>%
  select(town)
apac = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Town Centres/apac town centre/apac_town_centre.shp"), crs)%>%
  mutate(town = "Apac")%>%
  select(town)

town_centres = rbind(aduku, apac)

rm(aduku, apac)
```

## Households
```{r}
households = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Households/households_raw.gpkg"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., apac_kwania, .pred = st_intersects())%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(id = row_number())%>%
  select(id, town)%>%
  rename(geometry = geom)

paste(round(nrow(households%>%filter(is.na(town)))/nrow(households)*100, 2), "% of households outside of town centers")
```

## Water bodies
```{r}
water_bodies = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Water bodies/hotosm_uga_waterways_polygons_shp.shp"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., st_buffer(apac_kwania, 1000))
```



## Schools

OpenStreetMap point data of schools downloaded from [HumData](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_uga_education_facilities)
```{r}
schools = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Schools/hotosm_uga_education_facilities_points_shp.shp"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., apac_kwania, .pred = st_intersects())%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  distinct(name, .keep_all = T)%>%
  mutate(id = row_number())
```

## Healthcare facilities

Point data with lat/longs healthcare facilities from [Maina et al., 2019](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-019-0142-2#code-availability) and downloaded from [HumData](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/health-facilities-in-sub-saharan-africa)
```{r}
healthcare = st_transform(st_read("Raw data/Healthcare Facilities/sub-saharan_health_facilities.shp"), crs)%>%
  st_filter(., apac_kwania, .pred = st_intersects())%>%
  st_join(., town_centres)%>%
  mutate(id = row_number())
```


## Deduplicated water sources
```{r}
water_sources = st_transform(st_read("Processed data/water_source_dedups_apr24_2025.gpkg"))
```



# Preprocessing 

## Water Source Setup

We're going to create 9 sub-datasets of our master water source dataset: 3x deduplication versions (semi-conservative, aggressive, conservative) * 3x source types (all sources, non-surface sources, improved sources).
```{r}
variations = c("semi_all", "semi_nosurf", "semi_imp", "agg_all", "agg_nosurf", "agg_imp", "cons_all", "cons_nosurf", "cons_imp")

variations_schools_healthcare = c("semi_all", "semi_nosurf", "semi_imp", "semi_impyearround", "agg_all", "agg_nosurf", "agg_imp", "agg_impyearround", "cons_all", "cons_nosurf", "cons_imp", "cons_impyearround")
```

We're also going to separate out private and public sources, since we only want households nearby the private sources to have access to them in our proximity analyses. 
```{r}
private_sources = water_sources%>%filter(private == 1)

private_semi = private_sources%>%filter(semi == 1)
private_agg = private_sources%>%filter(agg == 1)
private_cons = private_sources

private_sources_list = list(private_semi, private_agg, private_cons)
```

For both private and public sources, we put the sub-datasets into lists we can loop through for each type of analysis. 
```{r}
public_sources = water_sources%>%filter(private == 0)

public_semi_all = public_sources%>%filter(semi == 1)
public_agg_all = public_sources%>%filter(agg == 1)
public_cons_all = public_sources

public_semi_nosurf = public_sources%>%filter(semi == 1 & surface == 0)
public_agg_nosurf = public_sources%>%filter(agg == 1 & surface == 0)
public_cons_nosurf = public_sources%>%filter(surface == 0)

public_semi_imp = public_sources%>%filter(semi == 1 & improved == 1)
public_agg_imp = public_sources%>%filter(agg == 1 & improved == 1)
public_cons_imp = public_sources%>%filter(improved == 1)

public_sources_list = list(public_semi_all, public_semi_nosurf, public_semi_imp, public_agg_all, public_agg_nosurf, public_agg_imp, public_cons_all, public_cons_nosurf, public_cons_imp)

public_sources_list_schools_healthcare = list(public_semi_all, public_semi_nosurf, public_semi_imp, public_semi_imp, public_agg_all, public_agg_nosurf, public_agg_imp, public_agg_imp, public_cons_all, public_cons_nosurf, public_cons_imp, public_cons_imp)
```

## Households, Schools, and Healthcare

We generate a dataset of household coordinates, and we calculate the distance from each household to any surface water bodies (since this would count as 'all sources' in addition to any point water source data). 
```{r}
dist_to_lake_hh = households%>%
  mutate(dist_to_lake = st_distance(geom, water_bodies)%>%apply(1, min),
         hh_id = row_number())%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  select(hh_id, dist_to_lake)
```

```{r}
school_coords = st_coordinates(schools)%>%data.frame()%>%
  mutate(school_id = row_number())
```

```{r}
healthcare_coords = st_coordinates(healthcare)%>%data.frame()%>%
  mutate(healthcare_id = row_number())

dist_to_lake_healthcare = healthcare%>%
  mutate(dist_to_lake = st_distance(geometry, water_bodies)%>%apply(1, min),
         healthcare_id = row_number())%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  select(healthcare_id, dist_to_lake)
```

```{r}
buffer_list = list(buffer100, buffer200, buffer300, buffer400, buffer500, buffer600, buffer700, buffer800, buffer900, buffer1000)
```

# Distance Calculations

We create a function to calculate the distance from each point (household, school, healthcare facility, etc.) to the nearest water source, under different variations of deduplication and source types. 

We record the distance from each household to the nearest 1) private source (only within the specified radius of 30m), 2) public source, and 3) in the analyses involving all sources (including surface water), to Lake Kwania. We then record the smallest distance 

We also record the % of point within different distances of a water source, saving those to another dataframe we will later use for visualisations. 

```{r}
calculate_access_distances <- function(
  water_sources,
  facility,
  variations) {
  
  percents_master <- c()
  
  dist_to_lake = facility%>%
    mutate(dist_to_lake = st_distance(geometry, water_bodies)%>%apply(1, min),
           id = row_number())%>%
    data.frame()%>%
    select(id, dist_to_lake)
  
  facility_coords = st_coordinates(facility)%>%data.frame()%>%
    mutate(id = row_number())

  for (i in seq_along(variations)) {
    variation <- variations[i]
    parts <- strsplit(variation, "_")[[1]]
    dedup_flag <- parts[1]     # e.g. "semi", "agg", "cons"
    source_flag <- parts[2]    # e.g. "all", "nosurf", "imp", "impyearround"

    # Filter public water sources using dummy columns
    pub_water_coords = st_coordinates(water_sources%>%filter(.data[[dedup_flag]] == 1 & .data[[source_flag]] == 1 & private == 0)) %>% data.frame()
    private_water_coods = st_coordinates(water_sources%>%filter(.data[[dedup_flag]] == 1 & .data[[source_flag]] == 1 & private == 1)) %>% data.frame()

    # Compute distances
    priv_dists <- data.frame(get.knnx(private_water_coords, facility_coords %>% select(-id), k = 1)) %>%
      mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
      filter(nn.dist <= priv_dist) %>%
      rename(priv_dist = nn.dist) %>%
      select(-nn.index)

    pub_dists <- data.frame(get.knnx(pub_water_coords, facility_coords %>% select(-id), k = 1)) %>%
      mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
      rename(pub_dist = nn.dist) %>%
      select(-nn.index)

    facility_dists <- full_join(pub_dists, priv_dists, by = "id") %>%
      mutate(min_dist = pmin(coalesce(priv_dist, Inf), coalesce(pub_dist, Inf)))

    # Include distance to lake if we are including surface water sources
    if (source_flag == "all") {
      facility_dists <- full_join(facility_dists, dist_to_lake, by = "id") %>%
        mutate(min_dist = pmin(min_dist, dist_to_lake))}

    # Save distances in facility data
    facility[[paste("dist", variation, sep = "_")]] <- facility_dists$min_dist

    # Calculate percentage access
    percents <- sapply(dist_thresholds, function(thresh) {
      mean(facility_dists$min_dist <= thresh, na.rm = TRUE) * 100})
    percents_master <- append(percents_master, percents)}

  # Create summary table
  dedup <- rep(dedup_names[sapply(variations, function(v) strsplit(v, "_")[[1]][1])], each = 5)
  source_type <- rep(source_names[sapply(variations, function(v) strsplit(v, "_")[[1]][2])], each = 5)
  distance <- rep(c("100", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000"), length(variations))

  summary <- data.frame(dedup, source_type, distance, percents_master)

  return(list(facility, summary))}
```

Another function to plot distance results
```{r}
plot_by_dedup <- function(df, facility_label) {
  
  # make sure your factor levels are set once
  df <- df %>%mutate(
      source_type = factor(source_type, levels = c(
          "Any Source (incl. surf. water)",
          "Any Source (excl. surf. water)",
          "Improved Source",
          "Year-Round Improved Source")))
  
  dedup_levels <- unique(df$dedup)
  
  for (lev in dedup_levels) {
    p <- df %>%
      filter(dedup == lev)%>%
      ggplot(aes(distance, percents_master, fill = source_type)) +
      geom_col(colour = "black", position = position_dodge(), alpha = 0.8) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("coral", "skyblue3", "green3", "#C8A2C8")) +
      labs(title = paste(facility_label, "–", lev), x     = "Distance to Water Source (m)", y = paste(facility_label, "Within Distance (%)"), fill  = "Water Source Type") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "vertical") +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)) +
      scale_x_discrete(
        limits = c("100","500","1000","1500","2000"),
        labels = c("100","500","1000","1500","2000")) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = round(percents_master, 1)),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
        vjust    = -0.25,
        size     = 3)
    
    print(p)}}
```

# # of sources within radius

## Households
```{r}
means_master = c()

for (i in c(1:length(public_sources_list))){
  print(i)
  
  pub_water = public_sources_list[[i]]

  if (i < 4){private_water = private_sources_list[[1]]}
  else if (i < 7){private_water = private_sources_list[[2]]}
  else {private_water = private_sources_list[[3]]}
    
  priv_counts = data.frame(buffer30%>%mutate(priv_count = lengths(st_intersects(., private_water))))%>%select(hh_id, priv_count)
      
  for (j in 1:length(buffer_list)){
    pub_counts = buffer_list[[j]]%>%mutate(pub_count = lengths(st_intersects(., pub_water)))%>%select(hh_id, pub_count)
    total_counts = left_join(pub_counts, priv_counts, by = "hh_id")%>%
      mutate(total_count = pub_count + priv_count)
    
    households[[paste0("num_sources_", variations[i])]] <- total_counts$total_count
    
    means_master = append(means_master, mean(total_counts$total_count))}}

dedup = rep(c("Semi-Conservative", "Aggressive", "Conservative"), each = 30)
source_type = rep(rep(c("Any Source (incl. surf. water)", "Any Source (excl. surf. water)", "Improved Source"), each = 10), 3)
distance = rep(c("100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "600", "700", "800", "900", "1000"), 9)

master = data.frame(dedup, source_type, distance, means_master)

master$source_type = factor(master$source_type, levels = c("Any Source (incl. surf. water)", "Any Source (excl. surf. water)", "Improved Source"))
```

```{r}
master$source_type = factor(master$source_type, levels = c("Any Source (incl. surf. water)", "Any Source (excl. surf. water)", "Improved Source"))
master$dedup = factor(master$dedup, levels = c("Conservative", "Semi-Conservative", "Aggressive"))

plot = ggplot(master, aes(as.numeric(distance), means_master, colour = source_type))+
  facet_wrap(~dedup)+
  geom_line(size = 1)+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  theme_bw(base_size=14)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("coral", "skyblue3", "green3"))+
  labs(y="Mean Number of Sources \n Within Distance", x="Distance from Household (m)", colour="Water Source Type")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.box = "vertical")+
  guides(colour=guide_legend(nrow=3,byrow=TRUE))
plot
#ggsave("# of sources within radii (overall).jpg", width = 10, height = 7)
```
